[[File:BugAttractingSoap-TheHauntedVillage.png|thumb|right|The bug-attracting soap]]
The [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] knew how to make a '''bug-attracting soap'''. The [[Shaman/Legends|shaman]] [[Logray/Legends|Logray]] and the [[Scout/Legends|scout]] [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]] tricked the [[King/Legends|King]] [[Gorneesh/Legends|Gorneesh]] and his [[Gorneesh's tribe|tribe]] of [[Dulok/Legends|Duloks]] into stealing the [[Insect/Legends|bug]]-attracting soap. The Ewoks then released insects that, attracted to the soap, chased the Duloks away.
